metadata.description: deepseek-supervisor: checks what Claude Code on a third-party model claims, by running it

plugins.name: deepseek-supervisor
plugins.description: A check for Claude Code on a third-party model such as DeepSeek: when the model claims something is done, passing or right, a verifier runs the cheapest command that would show it false in a throwaway copy of the workspace, and hands the model the output
